title: Financial Stability Oversight Council Improvement Act of 2025
short_title: Financial Stability Oversight Council Improvement Act of 2025
committees: S-Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee: Referred To 2026-02-11 || H-Financial Services Committee: Referred To 2025-06-03 -> Markup By 2025-09-16 -> Reported By 2025-11-04
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: Financial Stability Oversight Council Improvement Act of 2025 This bill requires the Financial Stability Oversight Council, prior to determining that a U.S. nonbank financial company shall be supervised by the Federal Reserve Board and therefore subject to certain prudential standards, to first determine that certain alternative actions would not mitigate the threat the company may pose to U.S. financial stability.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
